    n, m, t = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    tp, tu, td = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    heights = [list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n)]

    def calculate_time(ul_row, ul_col, lr_row, lr_col):
        time = 0
        directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
        x, y = ul_row, ul_col
        prev_height = heights[x][y]
        for dx, dy in directions:
            for _ in range(lr_row - ul_row if dx == 0 else lr_col - ul_col):
                x += dx
                y += dy
                current_height = heights[x][y]
                if current_height > prev_height:
                    time += tu
                elif current_height < prev_height:
                    time += td
                else:
                    time += tp
                prev_height = current_height
        return time

    best_diff = float('inf')
    best_rectangle = None

    for ul_row in range(n - 2):
        for ul_col in range(m - 2):
            for lr_row in range(ul_row + 2, n):
                for lr_col in range(ul_col + 2, m):
                    ts = calculate_time(ul_row, ul_col, lr_row, lr_col)
                    diff = abs(ts - t)
                    if diff < best_diff:
                        best_diff = diff
                        best_rectangle = (ul_row + 1, ul_col + 1, lr_row + 1, lr_col + 1)

    print(best_rectangle[0], best_rectangle[1], best_rectangle[2], best_rectangle[3])
